title.narrative: Eliminating malaria through the avoidance of its re-establishment

description.narrative: Suriname - Malaria - Ministry of Health of the Republic of Suriname - MOH. This program has the following goals: Contain imported malaria and local outbreaks and prevent the re-introduction of Malaria in Suriname while moving towards elimination. The objectives of this program are: Treat freely 95% of malaria cases. Track and report 90% of the cases with diagnosis. Achieve parasitology confirmation of all cases. Achieve more than 90% coverage of LLIN's in selected high risk and vulnerable population. Increase the percentage of Malaria knowledge
